lessons.title: Make a high-stakes recommendation with precision
lessons.scenario: “Operations supports a pilot if weekend data are collected. Finance prefers a cap on overtime. The service lead says any cap must not leave the busiest shift uncovered. No team has yet estimated the effect on customer satisfaction.”

flashcards.question: What does the proposed pilot test?
flashcards.answer: longer response times in two peak periods; weekend performance and broader causes; whether temporary staffing improves service within an acceptable cost

assessment: 0–2 each for factual fidelity, explicit uncertainty, workable safeguards, and concise register. Success: 6/8 with no invented facts; specialist review is required for actual operational decisions.
